"""The month-end close: one agent run from a month of PRs to a proposed ledger.

    plan -> per PR: diff checks, JEV gates, oracle, sandbox  (checkpointed)
         -> cross-PR anti-gaming -> scoring -> allocation + invariants
         -> receipts -> proposed ledger -> report

Every PR's progress is saved in SQLite as soon as a stage finishes, so a
crashed run resumes where it stopped. Nothing is paid until a maintainer
approves the proposed ledger (`linus approve`).
"""

import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import neatlogs

from linus import __version__, diffcheck, gates, ledger, sandbox, scoring
from linus import oracle as oracle_mod
from linus import verify as verify_mod
from linus.allocate import allocate, check_invariants
from linus.config import Settings
from linus.diffcheck import DiffSignals
from linus.jev import USD_PER_INPUT_TOKEN, Jev
from linus.llm import Generator, usd
from linus.oracle import Oracle
from linus.policy import Policy
from linus.source import Issue, LocalSource, PullRequest
from linus.store import Store
from linus.tracing import annotate, step, trace_id_of

VERDICT = {"verified": "pay", "not_fixed": "reject", "regression": "reject", "tampering": "reject",
           "needs_human": "flag", "inconclusive": "flag"}


def conflicting(answers: dict, signals: DiffSignals, oracle_run: dict) -> bool:
    """The sandbox says 'not fixed' but everything else says 'honest, complete fix'.

    Oracles are generated, so they can be wrong. When a minority of cases fail and
    JEV is confident the diff fully fixes the issue with no gaming signals, don't
    auto-reject: route it to a human. (Never auto-pays either.)
    """
    addresses = answers.get("addresses_issue", {}).get("probabilities", {})
    full_fix = float(addresses.get("2", addresses.get(2, 0))) >= 0.8
    honest = (answers.get("special_casing", {}).get("noul", 1) < 0.5
              and answers.get("claims_match", {}).get("noul", 0) >= 0.5
              and not signals.tampering)
    total = oracle_run["passed"] + oracle_run["failed"]
    minority = total > 0 and oracle_run["failed"] * 3 <= total
    return full_fix and honest and minority


def corroboration(answers: dict, signals: DiffSignals) -> str:
    """Cheap signals that agree with a sandbox rejection, for the contributor."""
    notes = []
    if signals.removed_tests:
        notes.append(f"deletes {', '.join(signals.removed_tests)}")
    if signals.added_skips:
        notes.append(f"adds {signals.added_skips} skip marker(s)")
    if answers.get("special_casing", {}).get("noul", 0) >= 0.8:
        notes.append(f"JEV: hard-codes literal inputs (p={answers['special_casing']['noul']:.2f})")
    if answers.get("claims_match", {}).get("noul", 1) <= 0.3:
        notes.append(f"JEV: PR body claims changes the diff doesn't make (p={answers['claims_match']['noul']:.2f})")
    return f"; {'; '.join(notes)}" if notes else ""


def oracle_record(oracle: Oracle) -> dict:
    """The oracle exactly as used, frozen into the PR's item at verification time:
    receipts are built from this, so a later run can't swap the shared cache under it."""
    record = {k: getattr(oracle, k) for k in ("issue", "valid", "test_path", "test_sha256", "test_code",
                                              "model", "cases", "dropped")}
    record["attempts"] = [{"attempt": a["attempt"], "proposed": a.get("proposed"), "kept": a.get("kept"),
                           "problem": a.get("problem"),
                           "base_outcome": (a.get("base_run") or {}).get("outcome"),
                           "base_failed": (a.get("base_run") or {}).get("failed")}
                          for a in oracle.attempts]
    return record


class Close:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, source: LocalSource, policy: Policy, ui,
                 run_id: str | None = None, crash_after: int | None = None,
                 reuse_oracles: bool = True) -> None:
        self.settings, self.source, self.policy, self.ui = settings, source, policy, ui
        self.reuse_oracles = reuse_oracles
        self.store = Store(settings.state_dir / "linus.db")
        self.jev = Jev(settings)
        self.gen = Generator(settings)
        self.crash_after = crash_after
        self.resumed = run_id is not None
        # The random suffix keeps two runs started in the same second apart.
        self.run_id = run_id or (f"{source.period}-{datetime.now(timezone.utc):%Y%m%d-%H%M%S}"
                                 f"-{secrets.token_hex(2)}")
        self.run_dir = settings.state_dir / "runs" / self.run_id
        self.workdir = settings.state_dir / "work"
        self.workdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # -- per PR ---------------------------------------------------------------

    def _issue(self, pr: PullRequest) -> Issue | None:
        for n in pr.issue_numbers:
            issue = self.source.issues.get(n)
            if issue and set(issue.labels) & set(self.policy.issue_labels):
                return issue
        return None

    def _gate(self, pr: PullRequest, issue: Issue | None, data: dict) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
        diff = self.source.diff(pr)
        signals = diffcheck.analyze(diff, self.source.changes(pr), f"{pr.title}\n{pr.body}")
        data["signals"] = asdict(signals)
        data["issue"] = issue.number if issue else None
        if why := self.policy.excluded(pr.author):
            return "reject", why
        if signals.manipulates_outcome:
            return "reject", "changes test outcomes instead of the code: " + "; ".join(signals.outcome_hacks[:3])
        if signals.docs_only and not self.policy.include_docs:
            return "reject", "docs-only PRs are not eligible under bounty.yml"
        if not signals.docs_only and issue is None:
            return "reject", "does not fix an issue labelled for this bounty"
        gate = gates.run(self.jev, pr, issue, diff, signals)
        data["gate"] = asdict(gate)
        if gate.decision == "reject":
            return "reject", gate.reason
        return None, ""

    def _oracle(self, issue: Issue, pr: PullRequest, signals: DiffSignals) -> Oracle:
        # Only a valid oracle in the current format is reused: a failed build may have
        # been bad luck or a Docker problem. Infrastructure errors propagate before
        # anything is cached.
        cached = self.store.oracle(self.source.name, issue.number, pr.base_sha)
        current = cached and cached.get("valid") and cached.get("format") == oracle_mod.FORMAT
        if current and (self.reuse_oracles or cached.get("run_id") == self.run_id):
            return Oracle.from_dict(cached)
        built = oracle_mod.build(self.gen, self.jev, self.source, issue, pr.base_sha,
                                 set(signals.code_files), self.workdir)
        self.store.save_oracle(self.source.name, issue.number, pr.base_sha,
                               built.to_dict() | {"run_id": self.run_id})
        return built

    def _finish(self, pr: PullRequest, span, data: dict, verdict: str, reason: str,
                started: float, tokens0: tuple[int, int, int]) -> None:
        data["verdict"], data["reason"] = verdict, reason
        data["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started + data.get("seconds", 0), 2)
        cost = data.setdefault("cost", {})
        for key, value in (("jev_tokens", self.jev.input_tokens - tokens0[0]),
                           ("openai_in", self.gen.prompt_tokens - tokens0[1]),
                           ("openai_out", self.gen.completion_tokens - tokens0[2])):
            cost[key] = cost.get(key, 0) + value
        self.store.save_item(self.run_id, pr.number, "done", verdict, data)
        annotate(span, verdict=verdict, reason=reason)
        self.ui.item(pr, verdict, reason, data)

    def process(self, pr: PullRequest, item: dict | None) -> None:
        """Judge one PR. Any failure flags this PR for a human and the close goes
        on: one malformed PR must not stop the month, or crash every resume."""
        data = item["data"] if item else {}
        stage = item["stage"] if item else "queued"
        started = time.monotonic()
        tokens0 = (self.jev.input_tokens, self.gen.prompt_tokens, self.gen.completion_tokens)
        with step(f"pr_{pr.number}", kind="AGENT", author=pr.author, title=pr.title) as span:
            try:
                verdict, reason = self._judge(pr, data, stage)
            except sandbox.InfrastructureError as exc:
                data["error"] = f"InfrastructureError: {exc}"
                verdict, reason = "flag", f"sandbox infrastructure failed, nothing was judged: {exc}"
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - recorded on the PR, the run continues
                data["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                verdict, reason = "flag", f"could not process this PR: {data['error']}"
            self._finish(pr, span, data, verdict, reason[:500], started, tokens0)

    def _judge(self, pr: PullRequest, data: dict, stage: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        issue = self._issue(pr)
        if stage == "queued":
            verdict, reason = self._gate(pr, issue, data)
            if verdict:
                return verdict, reason
            self.store.save_item(self.run_id, pr.number, "gated", None, data)

        signals = DiffSignals(**data["signals"])
        oracle = None
        if not signals.docs_only:
            oracle = self._oracle(issue, pr, signals)
            data["oracle"] = oracle_record(oracle)
            if not oracle.valid:
                return "flag", f"could not build a reproduction test for #{issue.number}"
        result = verify_mod.verify(self.source, pr, oracle, signals, self.workdir)
        data["verification"] = asdict(result)
        verdict, reason = VERDICT[result.outcome], result.reason
        answers = data.get("gate", {}).get("answers", {})
        if result.outcome == "not_fixed" and conflicting(answers, signals, result.runs[0]):
            verdict = "flag"
            reason = (f"evidence conflicts: {result.reason}, but every cheap signal says this fully "
                      f"fixes #{issue.number}; a human should check the failing case")
        elif verdict == "reject":
            reason += corroboration(answers, signals)
        elif verdict == "pay" and signals.touches_test_harness:
            verdict = "flag"
            reason = (f"{result.reason}, but the PR edits the test harness "
                      f"({', '.join(signals.harness_files)}); a human should check it doesn't change "
                      f"how tests run")
        return verdict, reason

    # -- across PRs -----------------------------------------------------------

    def anti_gaming(self, pulls: list[PullRequest], items: dict[int, dict]) -> None:
        """Every PR is compared with every earlier PR on the same issue (docs-only
        PRs with earlier docs-only PRs), whatever their verdicts: a copy of a
        rejected PR is still a copy. The first verified fix for an issue wins, and
        a later fix waits while an earlier one is with a human."""
        with step("anti_gaming", kind="GUARDRAIL") as span:
            earlier: dict[object, list[PullRequest]] = {}
            prints: dict[int, set[str]] = {}
            changed = []
            for pr in pulls:
                item = items.get(pr.number)
                if not item or not item["data"].get("signals"):
                    continue
                data = item["data"]
                docs = DiffSignals(**data["signals"]).docs_only
                group = "docs" if docs else data.get("issue")
                if group is None:
                    continue
                prints[pr.number] = diffcheck.change_fingerprint(self.source.diff(pr))
                before = earlier.setdefault(group, [])
                found = self._against_earlier(pr, before, items, prints, docs)
                before.append(pr)
                if not found:
                    continue
                verdict, reason, other, sim = found
                data["anti_gaming"] = {"winner": other, "similarity": round(sim, 3)}
                data["verdict"], data["reason"] = verdict, reason
                item["verdict"] = verdict
                self.store.save_item(self.run_id, pr.number, "done", verdict, data)
                changed.append(pr.number)
                self.ui.item(pr, verdict, reason, data, late=True)
            annotate(span, changed=changed)

    def _against_earlier(self, pr: PullRequest, before: list[PullRequest], items: dict[int, dict],
                         prints: dict[int, set[str]], docs: bool) -> tuple[str, str, int, float] | None:
        """A new (verdict, reason, other PR, similarity) for `pr`, or None to keep its verdict."""
        if not before:
            return None
        sims = {p.number: diffcheck.similarity(prints[p.number], prints[pr.number]) for p in before}
        closest = max(before, key=lambda p: sims[p.number])
        verdict = items[pr.number]["verdict"]
        if sims[closest.number] >= self.policy.duplicate_similarity and verdict != "reject":
            return ("reject", f"copy of #{closest.number} ({sims[closest.number]:.0%} of changed lines "
                    f"identical), submitted later", closest.number, sims[closest.number])
        if docs or verdict != "pay":
            return None
        issue = items[pr.number]["data"]["issue"]
        if paid := next((p for p in before if items[p.number]["verdict"] == "pay"), None):
            return ("reject", f"issue #{issue} was already fixed by #{paid.number}, submitted earlier",
                    paid.number, sims[paid.number])
        if flagged := next((p for p in before if items[p.number]["verdict"] == "flag"), None):
            return ("flag", f"verified, but waiting on #{flagged.number}'s human review: it targets "
                    f"#{issue} and was submitted earlier", flagged.number, sims[flagged.number])
        return None

    def settle(self, pulls: list[PullRequest], items: dict[int, dict]) -> dict:
        policy = self.policy
        with step("settle", kind="CHAIN") as span:
            points: dict[str, float] = {}
            paid_prs: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
            for pr in pulls:
                item = items[pr.number]
                if item["verdict"] != "pay":
                    continue
                data = item["data"]
                pts = scoring.score(policy, data["gate"]["answers"], DiffSignals(**data["signals"]))
                data["points"] = asdict(pts)
                self.store.save_item(self.run_id, pr.number, "done", "pay", data)
                points[pr.author] = points.get(pr.author, 0) + pts.points
                paid_prs.setdefault(pr.author, []).append(pr.number)

            primary = policy.primary_currency
            allocations = [allocate(points, primary, policy.budget[primary], policy.cap_fraction, policy.min_payout)]
            survivors = {c: points[c] for c in allocations[0].payouts}
            for currency, amount in list(policy.budget.items())[1:]:
                allocations.append(allocate(survivors, currency, amount, policy.cap_fraction, None))

            ledger_path = self.settings.state_dir / "ledger.jsonl"
            verified = {pr.number for pr in pulls if items[pr.number]["verdict"] == "pay"}
            with step("invariants", kind="GUARDRAIL") as guard:
                problems = check_invariants(
                    allocations, policy.cap_fraction, policy.min_payout, primary,
                    {c: paid_prs[c] for c in allocations[0].payouts}, verified,
                    ledger.paid_prs(ledger_path, self.source.name), set(policy.excluded_authors))
                annotate(guard, problems=problems, ok=not problems)
            status = "halted" if problems else "proposed"

            try:
                image = sandbox.image_id()
            except sandbox.InfrastructureError:
                image = "unavailable"
            receipt_hashes: dict[int, str] = {}
            for pr in pulls:
                receipt = self._receipt(pr, items[pr.number]["data"], allocations, image)
                _, digest = ledger.write_receipt(self.run_dir / "receipts", pr.number, receipt)
                receipt_hashes[pr.number] = digest

            entries = []
            proposal_sha256 = None
            if not problems:
                for a in allocations:
                    for who, cents in sorted(a.payouts.items()):
                        entries.append({
                            "type": "payout", "repo": self.source.name, "period": self.source.period,
                            "run_id": self.run_id, "contributor": who, "currency": a.currency,
                            "amount": cents / 100, "prs": paid_prs[who],
                            "receipts": [receipt_hashes[n] for n in paid_prs[who]],
                            "policy_sha256": policy.sha256,
                        })
                    if a.rollover_cents:
                        entries.append({"type": "rollover", "repo": self.source.name, "period": self.source.period,
                                        "run_id": self.run_id, "currency": a.currency,
                                        "amount": a.rollover_cents / 100})
                raw = "".join(ledger.canonical(e).decode() + "\n" for e in entries).encode()
                self.run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  # no receipts were written for an empty month
                (self.run_dir / "ledger.proposed.jsonl").write_bytes(raw)
                # `linus approve` refuses a proposal whose bytes no longer match this.
                proposal_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

            summary = self._summary(pulls, items, allocations, problems, status)
            summary["proposal_sha256"] = proposal_sha256
            self.store.finish_run(self.run_id, status, summary)
            annotate(span, status=status, problems=problems)
        return summary

    def _receipt(self, pr: PullRequest, data: dict, allocations, image: str) -> dict:
        oracle = data.get("oracle")  # frozen when the PR was verified, see oracle_record()
        payout = {a.currency: a.payouts.get(pr.author, 0) / 100 for a in allocations} \
            if data.get("verdict") == "pay" else {}
        return {
            "linus_version": __version__, "run_id": self.run_id, "repo": self.source.name,
            "period": self.source.period,
            "pr": {"number": pr.number, "title": pr.title, "author": pr.author, "created_at": pr.created_at,
                   "base_sha": pr.base_sha, "head_sha": pr.head_sha, "issues": list(pr.issue_numbers)},
            "verdict": data.get("verdict"), "reason": data.get("reason"),
            "signals": data.get("signals"), "gate": data.get("gate"), "oracle": oracle,
            "verification": data.get("verification"), "anti_gaming": data.get("anti_gaming"),
            "points": data.get("points"), "contributor_payout": payout,
            "sandbox_image": image, "policy_sha256": self.policy.sha256,
        }

    def _summary(self, pulls, items, allocations, problems, status) -> dict:
        def total(key: str) -> int:
            return sum(i["data"].get("cost", {}).get(key, 0) for i in items.values())

        jev_tokens, openai_in, openai_out = total("jev_tokens"), total("openai_in"), total("openai_out")
        openai_usd = usd(self.settings.openai_model, openai_in, openai_out)
        jev_usd = jev_tokens * USD_PER_INPUT_TOKEN
        seconds = sum(i["data"].get("seconds", 0) for i in items.values())
        return {
            "run_id": self.run_id, "repo": self.source.name, "period": self.source.period, "status": status,
            "problems": problems,
            "verdicts": {pr.number: {"author": pr.author, "verdict": items[pr.number]["verdict"],
                                     "reason": items[pr.number]["data"].get("reason"),
                                     "points": (items[pr.number]["data"].get("points") or {}).get("points")}
                         for pr in pulls},
            "allocations": [{"currency": a.currency, "budget": a.budget_cents / 100,
                             "payouts": {c: v / 100 for c, v in a.payouts.items()},
                             "rollover": a.rollover_cents / 100, "dropped": a.dropped} for a in allocations],
            "cost": {"jev_tokens": jev_tokens, "jev_usd": round(jev_usd, 6),
                     "openai_tokens": openai_in + openai_out, "openai_in": openai_in, "openai_out": openai_out,
                     "openai_usd": round(openai_usd, 6) if openai_usd is not None else None,
                     "openai_model": self.settings.openai_model,
                     "usd_per_pr": round((jev_usd + (openai_usd or 0)) / max(len(pulls), 1), 6),
                     "pr_seconds": round(seconds, 1), "prs": len(pulls)},
            "run_dir": str(self.run_dir),
            "trace_id": getattr(self, "trace_id", ""),
        }

    # -- the run --------------------------------------------------------------

    def run(self) -> dict:
        if self.resumed:
            existing = self.store.run(self.run_id)
            if not existing:
                raise ValueError(f"no run {self.run_id} to resume")
            if existing["status"] != "running":
                # A finished run's status (proposed, halted, approved) must never be overwritten.
                raise ValueError(f"run {self.run_id} is {existing['status']}; only unfinished runs can be resumed")
        else:
            self.store.create_run(self.run_id, self.source.name, self.source.period)
        pulls = self.source.pulls()
        with step("month_end_close", kind="WORKFLOW", run_id=self.run_id, repo=self.source.name,
                  period=self.source.period, prs=len(pulls), resumed=self.resumed) as root:
            self.trace_id = trace_id_of(root)
            self.ui.plan(self, pulls)
            processed = 0
            for pr in pulls:
                item = self.store.item(self.run_id, pr.number)
                if item and item["stage"] == "done":
                    self.ui.item(pr, item["verdict"], item["data"].get("reason", ""), item["data"], resumed=True)
                    continue
                self.process(pr, item)
                processed += 1
                if self.crash_after and processed >= self.crash_after:
                    self.ui.crash(self.run_id, processed)
                    neatlogs.flush()
                    os._exit(137)  # simulated hard crash: no cleanup, no finally blocks
            items = self.store.items(self.run_id)
            self.anti_gaming(pulls, items)
            summary = self.settle(pulls, items)
            annotate(root, status=summary["status"])
        self.ui.done(summary)
        return summary

Five PRs are honest work. Eight are the attacks bounty programs actually see:
slop that claims a fix it doesn't make, prompt injection aimed at AI
reviewers, a fix hard-coded to the issue's example, a "fix" that deletes the
test it breaks, a copy of someone else's PR, a partial fix, a conftest that
forges a green pytest run, and a return value whose == is always True.

The expected verdicts live in a separate file that only `linus eval` reads,
so the agent never sees the answers.

Small text and list helpers.

```python
from textkit import chunk, parse_duration, slugify

chunk([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)          # [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
slugify("hello")                # "hello"
parse_duration("1h30m")         # 3600
```
'''

PYPROJECT = '''[project]
name = "textkit"
version = "0.3.0"
requires-python = ">=3.10"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]
'''

INIT = '''"""textkit: small text and list helpers."""

from textkit.core import chunk, parse_duration, slugify, truncate, word_count

__all__ = ["chunk", "parse_duration", "slugify", "truncate", "word_count"]

CORE = '''"""Core helpers."""

import re

_UNITS = {"h": 3600, "m": 60}


def chunk(items, size):
    """Split ``items`` into lists of length ``size``."""
    if size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("size must be positive")
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items) - size + 1, size)]


def slugify(text):
    """Turn ``text`` into a URL slug."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text.lower())


def parse_duration(text):
    """Parse durations like ``"1h30m"`` into seconds."""
    total = 0
    for value, unit in re.findall(r"(\\d+)([hms])", text):
        total += int(value) * _UNITS.get(unit, 0)
    return total


def word_count(text):
    """Count the words in ``text``."""
    return len(text.split(" "))


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten ``text`` to at most ``limit`` characters, adding "..." if cut."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    return text[:limit] + "..."

def _apply(files: dict[str, str], edits) -> dict[str, str]:
    out = dict(files)
    for path, old, new in edits:
        content = out.get(path, "")
        if old is None:
            out[path] = content.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + new.lstrip("\n") if content else new
            continue
        if content.count(old) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"edit for {path} does not match exactly once: {old[:60]!r}")
        out[path] = content.replace(old, new)
    return out


def _git(repo: Path, *args: str, env: dict | None = None) -> str:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
        env={**os.environ, **(env or {})},
    )
    return result.stdout.strip()


def _write(repo: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    for path, content in files.items():
        target = repo / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(content)


def _commit(repo: Path, author: str, when: str, message: str) -> None:
    email = f"{author}@users.noreply.example.com"
    env = {
        "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME": author, "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL": email, "GIT_AUTHOR_DATE": when,
        "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME": author, "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL": email, "GIT_COMMITTER_DATE": when,
    }
    _git(repo, "add", "-A")
    _git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", message, env=env)


def build(root: Path, force: bool = False) -> Path:
    """Create the demo under `root` and return it. Layout:

    root/repo/           git repo: main + one branch per PR
    root/fixture.json    issues and PR metadata (what GitHub would tell us)
    root/expected.json   ground-truth verdicts, read only by evals
    """
    if root.exists():
        if not force:
            raise FileExistsError(f"{root} exists; pass force=True to rebuild")
        shutil.rmtree(root)
    repo = root / "repo"
    repo.mkdir(parents=True)
    _git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    _git(repo, "config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
    _write(repo, BASE_FILES)
    _commit(repo, "maintainer", "2026-08-28T09:00:00Z", "textkit 0.3.0")

    for pr in PULLS:
        branch = f"pr/{pr['number']}"
        _git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "-b", branch, "main")
        _write(repo, _apply(BASE_FILES, pr["edits"]))
        _commit(repo, pr["author"], pr["created_at"], pr["title"])
        _git(repo, "checkout", "-q", "main")

    fixture = {
        "repo": "demo/textkit",
        "period": PERIOD,
        "default_branch": "main",
        "issues": ISSUES,
        "pulls": [
            {k: pr[k] for k in ("number", "author", "created_at", "title", "body")}
            | {"branch": f"pr/{pr['number']}", "base": "main"}
            for pr in PULLS
        ],
    }
    (root / "fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps(fixture, indent=2))
    expected = {str(n): {"verdict": v, "why": why} for n, (v, why) in EXPECTED.items()}
    (root / "expected.json").write_text(json.dumps(expected, indent=2))
    return root

"""Settings loaded from .env / the environment."""

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    jev_api_key: str
    jev_model: str
    jev_base_url: str
    openai_api_key: str
    openai_model: str
    openai_reasoning: str
    neatlogs_api_key: str
    neatlogs_workflow_name: str
    neatlogs_endpoint: str
    github_token: str
    target_repo: str
    state_dir: Path

    def problems(self) -> list[str]:
        """Human-readable list of missing or invalid settings."""
        required = {
            "JEV_API_KEY": self.jev_api_key,
            "JEV_MODEL": self.jev_model,
            "OPENAI_API_KEY": self.openai_api_key,
            "LINUS_OPENAI_MODEL": self.openai_model,
        }
        found = [f"{name} is empty" for name, value in required.items() if not value]
        if self.target_repo and self.target_repo.count("/") != 1:
            found.append(f"LINUS_TARGET_REPO={self.target_repo!r}, expected owner/name")
        return found


def _api_root(url: str) -> str:
    """Accept either the API root or the full /v1/systemone endpoint."""
    return url.strip().rstrip("/").removesuffix("/v1/systemone")


def load_settings(env_file: str | Path = ".env") -> Settings:
    load_dotenv(env_file, override=False)

    def get(key: str, default: str = "") -> str:
        return os.getenv(key, default).strip()

    return Settings(
        jev_api_key=get("JEV_API_KEY"),
        jev_model=get("JEV_MODEL", "jev-1.13.0"),
        jev_base_url=_api_root(get("JEV_BASE_URL")),
        openai_api_key=get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
        openai_model=get("LINUS_OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4-mini"),
        openai_reasoning=get("LINUS_OPENAI_REASONING", "low"),
        neatlogs_api_key=get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY"),
        neatlogs_workflow_name=get("NEATLOGS_WORKFLOW_NAME", "linus"),
        neatlogs_endpoint=get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT"),
        github_token=get("GITHUB_TOKEN"),
        target_repo=get("LINUS_TARGET_REPO"),
        state_dir=Path(get("LINUS_STATE_DIR", ".linus")),
    )

"""SQLite state. Every PR's progress is saved the moment a stage finishes, so a
crashed run resumes where it stopped instead of re-verifying (or re-paying).
"""

import json
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT, repo TEXT, period TEXT,
    status TEXT, summary TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
    run_id TEXT, pr INTEGER, stage TEXT, verdict TEXT, data TEXT, updated_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, pr)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oracles (
    repo TEXT, issue INTEGER, base_sha TEXT, data TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (repo, issue, base_sha)
);
"""


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(path)
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.executescript(SCHEMA)

    def create_run(self, run_id: str, repo: str, period: str) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute("INSERT INTO runs VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'running', '{}')",
                            (run_id, now(), repo, period))

    def run(self, run_id: str) -> dict | None:
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None

    def runs(self) -> list[dict]:
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC")]

    def latest_unfinished(self, repo: str, period: str) -> str | None:
        row = self.db.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM runs WHERE repo = ? AND period = ? AND status = 'running' "
            "ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1", (repo, period)).fetchone()
        return row["id"] if row else None

    def finish_run(self, run_id: str, status: str, summary: dict) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute("UPDATE runs SET status = ?, summary = ? WHERE id = ?",
                            (status, json.dumps(summary, default=str), run_id))

    def item(self, run_id: str, pr: int) -> dict | None:
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE run_id = ? AND pr = ?", (run_id, pr)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        return {"stage": row["stage"], "verdict": row["verdict"], "data": json.loads(row["data"])}

    def items(self, run_id: str) -> dict[int, dict]:
        rows = self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,))
        return {r["pr"]: {"stage": r["stage"], "verdict": r["verdict"], "data": json.loads(r["data"])}
                for r in rows}

    def save_item(self, run_id: str, pr: int, stage: str, verdict: str | None, data: dict) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO items VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (run_id, pr) DO UPDATE SET "
                "stage = excluded.stage, verdict = excluded.verdict, data = excluded.data, "
                "updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
                (run_id, pr, stage, verdict, json.dumps(data, default=str), now()))

    def oracle(self, repo: str, issue: int, base_sha: str) -> dict | None:
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT data FROM oracles WHERE repo = ? AND issue = ? AND base_sha = ?",
                              (repo, issue, base_sha)).fetchone()
        return json.loads(row["data"]) if row else None

    def save_oracle(self, repo: str, issue: int, base_sha: str, data: dict) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO oracles VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                            (repo, issue, base_sha, json.dumps(data, default=str)))
"""What humans see: live console output during a close, and report.md after."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.table import Table

STYLE = {"pay": ("PAY", "bold green"), "reject": ("REJECT", "bold red"), "flag": ("FLAG", "bold yellow")}


def _money(amount: float, currency: str) -> str:
    return f"${amount:,.2f}" if currency == "USD" else f"{amount:,.2f} {currency}"


class ConsoleUI:
    def __init__(self, console: Console) -> None:
        self.c = console

    def plan(self, close, pulls) -> None:
        budget = " + ".join(_money(v, k) for k, v in close.policy.budget.items())
        title = "Resuming" if close.resumed else "Month-end close"
        self.c.print(Panel.fit(
            f"[bold]{close.source.name}[/]  period {close.source.period}  ·  {len(pulls)} PRs  ·  pool {budget}\n"
            f"run [cyan]{close.run_id}[/]",
            title=f"Linus · {title}", border_style="cyan"))

    def item(self, pr, verdict: str | None, reason: str, data: dict, resumed: bool = False,
             late: bool = False) -> None:
        label, style = STYLE.get(verdict or "", ("?", "white"))
        tag = " [dim](checkpoint)[/]" if resumed else (" [dim](anti-gaming)[/]" if late else "")
        self.c.print(f"  #{pr.number}  {pr.author:<12} [{style}]{label:<6}[/]  {reason}{tag}")

    def crash(self, run_id: str, processed: int) -> None:
        self.c.print(f"\n[bold red]Simulated crash (kill -9) after {processed} PRs.[/] "
                     f"State is saved per PR. Resume with: [bold]uv run linus close --resume {run_id}[/]")

    def done(self, summary: dict) -> None:
        table = Table(title="Proposed payouts" if summary["status"] == "proposed" else "Payouts (halted)")
        table.add_column("contributor")
        table.add_column("PRs")
        for a in summary["allocations"]:
            table.add_column(a["currency"], justify="right")
        authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
        prs_by_author: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n, v in summary["verdicts"].items():
            if v["verdict"] == "pay":
                prs_by_author.setdefault(v["author"], []).append(f"#{n}")
        for who in authors:
            table.add_row(who, " ".join(prs_by_author.get(who, [])),
                          *[_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]])
        if any(a["rollover"] for a in summary["allocations"]):
            table.add_row("[dim]rollover[/]", "", *[_money(a["rollover"], a["currency"])
                                                    for a in summary["allocations"]])
        self.c.print()
        self.c.print(table)
        counts = {k: sum(1 for v in summary["verdicts"].values() if v["verdict"] == k)
                  for k in ("pay", "reject", "flag")}
        cost = summary["cost"]
        self.c.print(f"  verdicts: [green]{counts['pay']} pay[/] · [red]{counts['reject']} reject[/] · "
                     f"[yellow]{counts['flag']} flag[/]")
        openai_usd = f"${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else "price unknown"
        self.c.print(f"  cost: JEV {cost['jev_tokens']:,} tokens (${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}) · "
                     f"OpenAI {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens ({cost['openai_model']}, {openai_usd}) · "
                     f"[bold]${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f} per PR[/] · {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s of agent time")
        if summary["problems"]:
            self.c.print("[bold red]  invariants failed, nothing will be paid:[/]")
            for p in summary["problems"]:
                self.c.print(f"    - {p}")
        else:
            self.c.print("  invariants: [green]all hold[/] (sum = budget, caps, minimums, "
                         "verified receipts, no double pay)")
        self.c.print(f"  report: {summary['run_dir']}/report.md")
        if summary.get("trace_id"):
            self.c.print(f"  neatlogs trace: {summary['trace_id']}  (neatlogs trace get {summary['trace_id']})")
        if summary["status"] == "proposed":
            self.c.print(f"  next: review, then [bold]uv run linus approve {summary['run_id']}[/]")


def markdown(summary: dict) -> str:
    run_dir = Path(summary["run_dir"])
    lines = [
        f"# Linus close: {summary['repo']} · {summary['period']}",
        "",
        f"Run `{summary['run_id']}` · status **{summary['status']}**"
        + (f" · neatlogs trace `{summary['trace_id']}`" if summary.get("trace_id") else ""),
        "",
        "## Payouts",
        "",
    ]
    currencies = [a["currency"] for a in summary["allocations"]]
    lines.append("| Contributor | " + " | ".join(currencies) + " |")
    lines.append("|---|" + "---:|" * len(currencies))
    authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
    for who in authors:
        lines.append(f"| {who} | " + " | ".join(_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"])
                                                for a in summary["allocations"]) + " |")
    rollover = [a for a in summary["allocations"] if a["rollover"]]
    if rollover:
        lines.append("| _rollover to next month_ | " + " | ".join(
            _money(a["rollover"], a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]) + " |")
    lines += ["", "## Every PR", "", "| PR | Author | Verdict | Why | Points |", "|---|---|---|---|---:|"]
    for n, v in sorted(summary["verdicts"].items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        pts = f"{v['points']:g}" if v.get("points") else ""
        lines.append(f"| #{n} | {v['author']} | {v['verdict']} | {v['reason']} | {pts} |")

    lines += ["", "## Evidence", ""]
    for n in sorted(summary["verdicts"], key=int):
        path = run_dir / "receipts" / f"pr-{n}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        r = json.loads(path.read_text())
        lines.append(f"### #{n} {r['pr']['title']} ({r['pr']['author']})")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"- Verdict: **{r['verdict']}**: {r['reason']}")
        gate = (r.get("gate") or {}).get("answers") or {}
        if gate:
            bits = [f"{k} p={v['noul']:.2f}" for k, v in gate.items() if "noul" in v]
            bits += [f"{k} level {max(v['probabilities'], key=lambda x: v['probabilities'][x])} "
                     f"(conf {v['confidence']:.2f})" for k, v in gate.items() if "score" in v]
            lines.append(f"- JEV ({r['gate'].get('jev_model', '')}): " + ", ".join(bits))
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("injection_hits"):
            lines.append(f"- Injection text found: `{r['signals']['injection_hits'][0][:120]}`")
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("removed_tests"):
            lines.append(f"- Tests removed by the PR: {', '.join(r['signals']['removed_tests'])}")
        if r.get("oracle"):
            o = r["oracle"]
            tries = ", ".join(f"try {a['attempt']}: base {a['base_outcome']}" for a in o["attempts"])
            lines.append(f"- Oracle for #{o['issue']}: `{o['test_path']}` sha256 `{(o['test_sha256'] or '')[:12]}` "
                         f"({len(o.get('cases') or [])} cases; {tries})")
            for c in o.get("dropped") or []:
                lines.append(f"  - JEV dropped generated case `{c['call']} == {c['expected']}` "
                             f"(consistent with issue p={c['jev']:.2f})")
        for run in (r.get("verification") or {}).get("runs", []):
            lines.append(f"- Sandbox `{run['label']}`: {run['outcome']} "
                         f"({run['passed']} passed, {run['failed']} failed, {run['duration_s']}s)")
        if r.get("anti_gaming"):
            lines.append(f"- Anti-gaming: similarity {r['anti_gaming']['similarity']:.0%} to #{r['anti_gaming']['winner']}")
        if r.get("points"):
            lines.append(f"- Points: {r['points']['explanation']}")
        lines.append(f"- Receipt: `receipts/pr-{n}.json`")
        lines.append("")

    cost = summary["cost"]
    lines += [
        "## Cost", "",
        f"- JEV: {cost['jev_tokens']:,} input tokens, ${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}",
        f"- OpenAI ({cost['openai_model']}): {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens"
        + (f", ${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else ""),
        f"- Model cost per PR: ${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f}",
        f"- Agent time: {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s across {cost['prs']} PRs",
        "",
        "## Invariants", "",
    ]
    if summary["problems"]:
        lines += [f"- FAILED: {p}" for p in summary["problems"]]
    else:
        lines.append("- All hold: payouts + rollover = budget, per-contributor cap, minimum payout, "
                     "every payout backed by a verified receipt, nobody paid twice, no excluded authors.")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
"""Scores a close against ground truth. The headline metric is the false-pay
rate: money that went to a PR that should have been rejected.
"""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

HEADER = ("| When (UTC) | Label | Accuracy | False-pay | Missed-good | Human-flag "
          "| JEV $ | OpenAI tokens | Agent s/PR | Run | Trace |\n"
          "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|\n")
# Rows written before per-PR dollar cost was tracked keep the original columns.


def score(summary: dict, expected: dict) -> dict:
    rows = []
    for n, exp in sorted(expected.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        verdicts = summary["verdicts"]
        got = verdicts.get(int(n)) or verdicts.get(str(n))
        rows.append({"pr": int(n), "author": got["author"], "expected": exp["verdict"],
                     "got": got["verdict"], "ok": got["verdict"] == exp["verdict"],
                     "why_expected": exp["why"], "reason": got["reason"]})
    good = [r for r in rows if r["expected"] == "pay"]
    bad = [r for r in rows if r["expected"] == "reject"]
    false_pay = [r["pr"] for r in bad if r["got"] == "pay"]
    missed = [r["pr"] for r in good if r["got"] == "reject"]
    flagged = [r["pr"] for r in rows if r["got"] == "flag"]
    cost = summary["cost"]
    return {
        "run_id": summary["run_id"],
        "trace_id": summary.get("trace_id") or "",
        "accuracy": sum(r["ok"] for r in rows) / len(rows),
        "false_pay_rate": len(false_pay) / len(bad) if bad else 0.0,
        "missed_good_rate": len(missed) / len(good) if good else 0.0,
        "human_flag_rate": len(flagged) / len(rows),
        "false_pay": false_pay, "missed_good": missed, "flagged": flagged,
        "jev_usd": cost["jev_usd"], "openai_tokens": cost["openai_tokens"],
        "openai_usd": cost.get("openai_usd"), "usd_per_pr": cost.get("usd_per_pr"),
        "seconds_per_pr": cost["pr_seconds"] / max(cost["prs"], 1),
        "rows": rows,
    }


def save(result: dict, label: str, directory: Path) -> Path:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (directory / "results").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    when = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    result = {"label": label, "when": when, **result}
    path = directory / "results" / f"{result['run_id']}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    board = directory / "SCORECARD.md"
    if not board.exists():
        board.write_text("# Linus eval scorecard\n\nEvery row is a real run of `linus eval` against the "
                         "demo bounty month (13 PRs, 8 of them attacks). Ground truth: "
                         "`expected.json`, which the agent never sees.\n\n" + HEADER)
    trace = f"`{result['trace_id']}`" if result.get("trace_id") else "-"
    with board.open("a") as f:
        f.write(f"| {when} | {label or '-'} | {result['accuracy']:.0%} | {result['false_pay_rate']:.0%} "
                f"| {result['missed_good_rate']:.0%} | {result['human_flag_rate']:.0%} "
                f"| ${result['jev_usd']:.5f} | {result['openai_tokens']:,} "
                f"| {result['seconds_per_pr']:.1f} | `{result['run_id']}` | {trace} |\n")
    return path
"""neatlogs setup, plus `step()` for naming pipeline stages in the trace."""

import json
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import Any

import neatlogs

from linus.config import Settings


def init_tracing(settings: Settings) -> None:
    kwargs = {
        "api_key": settings.neatlogs_api_key,
        "workflow_name": settings.neatlogs_workflow_name,
    }
    if settings.neatlogs_endpoint:
        kwargs["endpoint"] = settings.neatlogs_endpoint
    neatlogs.init(**kwargs)


def shutdown_tracing() -> None:
    neatlogs.flush()
    neatlogs.shutdown()


def annotate(span: Any, **attrs: Any) -> None:
    for key, value in attrs.items():
        if not isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
            value = json.dumps(value, default=str)[:20_000]
        span.set_attribute(f"linus.{key}", value)


@contextmanager
def step(name: str, kind: str = "CHAIN", **attrs: Any) -> Iterator[Any]:
    """A user-facing span. trace() spans are internal by default, so un-hide it."""
    with neatlogs.trace(name=name, kind=kind) as span:
        span.set_attribute("neatlogs.internal", False)
        annotate(span, **attrs)
        yield span


def trace_id_of(span: Any) -> str:
    """The neatlogs/OpenTelemetry trace id, for `neatlogs trace get <id>`."""
    try:
        return f"{span.get_span_context().trace_id:032x}"
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - tracing must never break a run
        return ""
"""bounty.yml: the maintainer's rules for one pool."""

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import yaml


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Policy:
    budget: dict[str, float]
    issue_labels: tuple[str, ...]
    include_docs: bool
    base_points: float
    difficulty_points: tuple[float, ...]
    impact_multiplier: tuple[float, ...]
    docs_points: tuple[float, ...]
    cap_fraction: float
    min_payout: float
    duplicate_similarity: float
    exclude_bots: bool
    excluded_authors: frozenset[str]
    sha256: str

    @property
    def primary_currency(self) -> str:
        return next(iter(self.budget))

    def excluded(self, author: str) -> str | None:
        if author in self.excluded_authors:
            return "author is excluded by bounty.yml"
        if self.exclude_bots and (author.endswith("[bot]") or author.endswith("-bot")):
            return "bots are excluded by bounty.yml"
        return None


def load(path: Path) -> Policy:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    data = yaml.safe_load(raw)
    scoring, caps = data["scoring"], data["caps"]
    exclude = data.get("exclude", {})
    return Policy(
        budget={str(k): float(v) for k, v in data["budget"].items()},
        issue_labels=tuple(data["eligible"].get("issue_labels", ["bounty"])),
        include_docs=bool(data["eligible"].get("include_docs", True)),
        base_points=float(scoring["base"]),
        difficulty_points=tuple(float(x) for x in scoring["difficulty"]),
        impact_multiplier=tuple(float(x) for x in scoring["impact"]),
        docs_points=tuple(float(x) for x in scoring["docs"]),
        cap_fraction=float(caps["per_contributor_pct"]) / 100,
        min_payout=float(caps["min_payout"]),
        duplicate_similarity=float(data.get("anti_gaming", {}).get("duplicate_similarity", 0.8)),
        exclude_bots=bool(exclude.get("bots", True)),
        excluded_authors=frozenset(exclude.get("authors") or []),
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    )
"""Receipts and the tamper-evident ledger.

A receipt is canonical JSON of everything behind one PR's verdict; its
SHA-256 goes into the ledger. The ledger is append-only JSONL where each
entry carries the hash of the one before it, so editing any past entry breaks
every hash after it.
"""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

GENESIS = "0" * 64


def canonical(data: dict) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str).encode()


def sha256(data: dict) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(data)).hexdigest()


def write_receipt(directory: Path, number: int, receipt: dict) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = directory / f"pr-{number}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str))
    return path, sha256(receipt)


def read(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def append(path: Path, entries: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    existing = read(path)
    prev = existing[-1]["hash"] if existing else GENESIS
    seq = existing[-1]["seq"] + 1 if existing else 1
    written = []
    with path.open("a") as f:
        for entry in entries:
            body = {**entry, "seq": seq, "prev": prev}
            body["hash"] = sha256(body)
            f.write(json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
            written.append(body)
            prev, seq = body["hash"], seq + 1
    return written


def verify_chain(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    prev = GENESIS
    for i, entry in enumerate(read(path), start=1):
        body = {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k != "hash"}
        if entry.get("prev") != prev:
            problems.append(f"entry {i}: prev hash does not match entry {i - 1}")
        if sha256(body) != entry.get("hash"):
            problems.append(f"entry {i}: contents were modified (hash mismatch)")
        prev = entry.get("hash", "")
    return problems


def _cents(amount) -> int:
    return round(float(amount) * 100)


def _payout_problems(entry: dict, receipts_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Each paid PR must have an unchanged receipt that says pay, for this author."""
    who, prs, hashes = entry.get("contributor"), entry.get("prs") or [], entry.get("receipts") or []
    if not prs or len(prs) != len(hashes):
        return [f"{who}: payout lists {len(prs)} PRs but {len(hashes)} receipts"]
    problems = []
    for number, digest in zip(prs, hashes):
        path = receipts_dir / f"pr-{number}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            problems.append(f"#{number}: no receipt in this run")
            continue
        receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
        if sha256(receipt) != digest:
            problems.append(f"#{number}: receipt does not match the hash in the proposal")
        if (receipt.get("pr") or {}).get("author") != who:
            problems.append(f"#{number}: paid to {who} but authored by {(receipt.get('pr') or {}).get('author')}")
        if receipt.get("verdict") != "pay":
            problems.append(f"#{number}: receipt verdict is {receipt.get('verdict')}, not pay")
    return problems


def proposal_problems(raw: bytes, summary: dict, receipts_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Why a proposed ledger must not be appended, if anything. It must be the
    exact file the close wrote, and its entries must still hold the invariants."""
    expected = summary.get("proposal_sha256")
    if not expected:
        return ["the run has no recorded proposal hash; re-run the close"]
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
        return ["ledger.proposed.jsonl changed since the close wrote it"]
    budgets = {a["currency"]: _cents(a["budget"]) for a in summary.get("allocations", [])}
    totals = dict.fromkeys(budgets, 0)
    problems = []
    for entry in (json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode().splitlines() if line.strip()):
        if (entry.get("run_id"), entry.get("repo")) != (summary.get("run_id"), summary.get("repo")):
            problems.append(f"entry for run {entry.get('run_id')} / {entry.get('repo')} is not from this run")
        currency = entry.get("currency")
        if currency not in totals:
            problems.append(f"entry in {currency}, which is not in this run's budget")
            continue
        totals[currency] += _cents(entry.get("amount", 0))
        if entry.get("type") == "payout":
            problems += _payout_problems(entry, receipts_dir)
        elif entry.get("type") != "rollover":
            problems.append(f"unexpected entry type {entry.get('type')!r}")
    for currency, cents in budgets.items():
        if totals[currency] != cents:
            problems.append(f"{currency}: payouts + rollover = {totals[currency] / 100:.2f}, "
                            f"budget is {cents / 100:.2f}")
    return problems


def paid_prs(path: Path, repo: str) -> set[int]:
    return {n for e in read(path) if e.get("type") == "payout" and e.get("repo") == repo
            for n in e.get("prs", [])}

"""SQLite state. Every PR's progress is saved the moment a stage finishes, so a
crashed run resumes where it stopped instead of re-verifying (or re-paying).
"""

import json
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT, repo TEXT, period TEXT,
    status TEXT, summary TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
    run_id TEXT, pr INTEGER, stage TEXT, verdict TEXT, data TEXT, updated_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, pr)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oracles (
    repo TEXT, issue INTEGER, base_sha TEXT, data TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (repo, issue, base_sha)
);
"""


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(path)
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.executescript(SCHEMA)

    def create_run(self, run_id: str, repo: str, period: str) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute("INSERT INTO runs VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'running', '{}')",
                            (run_id, now(), repo, period))

    def run(self, run_id: str) -> dict | None:
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None

    def runs(self) -> list[dict]:
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM runs ORDER BY created_at DESC")]

    def latest_unfinished(self, repo: str, period: str) -> str | None:
        row = self.db.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM runs WHERE repo = ? AND period = ? AND status = 'running' "
            "ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1", (repo, period)).fetchone()
        return row["id"] if row else None

    def finish_run(self, run_id: str, status: str, summary: dict) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute("UPDATE runs SET status = ?, summary = ? WHERE id = ?",
                            (status, json.dumps(summary, default=str), run_id))

    def item(self, run_id: str, pr: int) -> dict | None:
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE run_id = ? AND pr = ?", (run_id, pr)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return None
        return {"stage": row["stage"], "verdict": row["verdict"], "data": json.loads(row["data"])}

    def items(self, run_id: str) -> dict[int, dict]:
        rows = self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM items WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,))
        return {r["pr"]: {"stage": r["stage"], "verdict": r["verdict"], "data": json.loads(r["data"])}
                for r in rows}

    def save_item(self, run_id: str, pr: int, stage: str, verdict: str | None, data: dict) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO items VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (run_id, pr) DO UPDATE SET "
                "stage = excluded.stage, verdict = excluded.verdict, data = excluded.data, "
                "updated_at = excluded.updated_at",
                (run_id, pr, stage, verdict, json.dumps(data, default=str), now()))

    def oracle(self, repo: str, issue: int, base_sha: str) -> dict | None:
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT data FROM oracles WHERE repo = ? AND issue = ? AND base_sha = ?",
                              (repo, issue, base_sha)).fetchone()
        return json.loads(row["data"]) if row else None

    def save_oracle(self, repo: str, issue: int, base_sha: str, data: dict) -> None:
        with self.db:
            self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO oracles VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                            (repo, issue, base_sha, json.dumps(data, default=str)))
"""What humans see: live console output during a close, and report.md after."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.table import Table

STYLE = {"pay": ("PAY", "bold green"), "reject": ("REJECT", "bold red"), "flag": ("FLAG", "bold yellow")}


def _money(amount: float, currency: str) -> str:
    return f"${amount:,.2f}" if currency == "USD" else f"{amount:,.2f} {currency}"


class ConsoleUI:
    def __init__(self, console: Console) -> None:
        self.c = console

    def plan(self, close, pulls) -> None:
        budget = " + ".join(_money(v, k) for k, v in close.policy.budget.items())
        title = "Resuming" if close.resumed else "Month-end close"
        self.c.print(Panel.fit(
            f"[bold]{close.source.name}[/]  period {close.source.period}  ·  {len(pulls)} PRs  ·  pool {budget}\n"
            f"run [cyan]{close.run_id}[/]",
            title=f"Linus · {title}", border_style="cyan"))

    def item(self, pr, verdict: str | None, reason: str, data: dict, resumed: bool = False,
             late: bool = False) -> None:
        label, style = STYLE.get(verdict or "", ("?", "white"))
        tag = " [dim](checkpoint)[/]" if resumed else (" [dim](anti-gaming)[/]" if late else "")
        self.c.print(f"  #{pr.number}  {pr.author:<12} [{style}]{label:<6}[/]  {reason}{tag}")

    def crash(self, run_id: str, processed: int) -> None:
        self.c.print(f"\n[bold red]Simulated crash (kill -9) after {processed} PRs.[/] "
                     f"State is saved per PR. Resume with: [bold]uv run linus close --resume {run_id}[/]")

    def done(self, summary: dict) -> None:
        table = Table(title="Proposed payouts" if summary["status"] == "proposed" else "Payouts (halted)")
        table.add_column("contributor")
        table.add_column("PRs")
        for a in summary["allocations"]:
            table.add_column(a["currency"], justify="right")
        authors = sorted({c for a in summary["allocations"] for c in a["payouts"]})
        prs_by_author: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for n, v in summary["verdicts"].items():
            if v["verdict"] == "pay":
                prs_by_author.setdefault(v["author"], []).append(f"#{n}")
        for who in authors:
            table.add_row(who, " ".join(prs_by_author.get(who, [])),
                          *[_money(a["payouts"].get(who, 0), a["currency"]) for a in summary["allocations"]])
        if any(a["rollover"] for a in summary["allocations"]):
            table.add_row("[dim]rollover[/]", "", *[_money(a["rollover"], a["currency"])
                                                    for a in summary["allocations"]])
        self.c.print()
        self.c.print(table)
        counts = {k: sum(1 for v in summary["verdicts"].values() if v["verdict"] == k)
                  for k in ("pay", "reject", "flag")}
        cost = summary["cost"]
        self.c.print(f"  verdicts: [green]{counts['pay']} pay[/] · [red]{counts['reject']} reject[/] · "
                     f"[yellow]{counts['flag']} flag[/]")
        openai_usd = f"${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else "price unknown"
        self.c.print(f"  cost: JEV {cost['jev_tokens']:,} tokens (${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}) · "
                     f"OpenAI {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens ({cost['openai_model']}, {openai_usd}) · "
                     f"[bold]${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f} per PR[/] · {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s of agent time")
        if summary["problems"]:

        else:

def markdown(summary: dict) -> str:

        if gate:
            bits = [f"{k} p={v['noul']:.2f}" for k, v in gate.items() if "noul" in v]
            bits += [f"{k} level {max(v['probabilities'], key=lambda x: v['probabilities'][x])} "
                     f"(conf {v['confidence']:.2f})" for k, v in gate.items() if "score" in v]
            lines.append(f"- JEV ({r['gate'].get('jev_model', '')}): " + ", ".join(bits))
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("injection_hits"):
            lines.append(f"- Injection text found: `{r['signals']['injection_hits'][0][:120]}`")
        if r.get("signals", {}).get("removed_tests"):
            lines.append(f"- Tests removed by the PR: {', '.join(r['signals']['removed_tests'])}")
        if r.get("oracle"):
            o = r["oracle"]
            tries = ", ".join(f"try {a['attempt']}: base {a['base_outcome']}" for a in o["attempts"])
            lines.append(f"- Oracle for #{o['issue']}: `{o['test_path']}` sha256 `{(o['test_sha256'] or '')[:12]}` "
                         f"({len(o.get('cases') or [])} cases; {tries})")
            for c in o.get("dropped") or []:
                lines.append(f"  - JEV dropped generated case `{c['call']} == {c['expected']}` "
                             f"(consistent with issue p={c['jev']:.2f})")
        for run in (r.get("verification") or {}).get("runs", []):
            lines.append(f"- Sandbox `{run['label']}`: {run['outcome']} "
                         f"({run['passed']} passed, {run['failed']} failed, {run['duration_s']}s)")
        if r.get("anti_gaming"):
            lines.append(f"- Anti-gaming: similarity {r['anti_gaming']['similarity']:.0%} to #{r['anti_gaming']['winner']}")
        if r.get("points"):
            lines.append(f"- Points: {r['points']['explanation']}")
        lines.append(f"- Receipt: `receipts/pr-{n}.json`")
        lines.append("")

    cost = summary["cost"]
    lines += [
        "## Cost", "",
        f"- JEV: {cost['jev_tokens']:,} input tokens, ${cost['jev_usd']:.5f}",
        f"- OpenAI ({cost['openai_model']}): {cost['openai_tokens']:,} tokens"
        + (f", ${cost['openai_usd']:.4f}" if cost.get("openai_usd") is not None else ""),
        f"- Model cost per PR: ${cost.get('usd_per_pr', 0):.4f}",
        f"- Agent time: {cost['pr_seconds']:.0f}s across {cost['prs']} PRs",
        "",
        "## Invariants", "",
    ]
    if summary["problems"]:
        lines += [f"- FAILED: {p}" for p in summary["problems"]]
    else:
        lines.append("- All hold: payouts + rollover = budget, per-contributor cap, minimum payout, "
                     "every payout backed by a verified receipt, nobody paid twice, no excluded authors.")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
"""Scores a close against ground truth. The headline metric is the false-pay
rate: money that went to a PR that should have been rejected.
"""

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

HEADER = ("| When (UTC) | Label | Accuracy | False-pay | Missed-good | Human-flag "
          "| JEV $ | OpenAI tokens | Agent s/PR | Run | Trace |\n"
          "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|\n")
# Rows written before per-PR dollar cost was tracked keep the original columns.


def score(summary: dict, expected: dict) -> dict:
    rows = []
    for n, exp in sorted(expected.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        verdicts = summary["verdicts"]
        got = verdicts.get(int(n)) or verdicts.get(str(n))
        rows.append({"pr": int(n), "author": got["author"], "expected": exp["verdict"],
                     "got": got["verdict"], "ok": got["verdict"] == exp["verdict"],
                     "why_expected": exp["why"], "reason": got["reason"]})
    good = [r for r in rows if r["expected"] == "pay"]
    bad = [r for r in rows if r["expected"] == "reject"]
    false_pay = [r["pr"] for r in bad if r["got"] == "pay"]
    missed = [r["pr"] for r in good if r["got"] == "reject"]
    flagged = [r["pr"] for r in rows if r["got"] == "flag"]
    cost = summary["cost"]
    return {
        "run_id": summary["run_id"],
        "trace_id": summary.get("trace_id") or "",
        "accuracy": sum(r["ok"] for r in rows) / len(rows),
        "false_pay_rate": len(false_pay) / len(bad) if bad else 0.0,
        "missed_good_rate": len(missed) / len(good) if good else 0.0,
        "human_flag_rate": len(flagged) / len(rows),
        "false_pay": false_pay, "missed_good": missed, "flagged": flagged,
        "jev_usd": cost["jev_usd"], "openai_tokens": cost["openai_tokens"],
        "openai_usd": cost.get("openai_usd"), "usd_per_pr": cost.get("usd_per_pr"),
        "seconds_per_pr": cost["pr_seconds"] / max(cost["prs"], 1),
        "rows": rows,
    }


def save(result: dict, label: str, directory: Path) -> Path:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (directory / "results").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    when = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    result = {"label": label, "when": when, **result}
    path = directory / "results" / f"{result['run_id']}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
    board = directory / "SCORECARD.md"
    if not board.exists():
        board.write_text("# Linus eval scorecard\n\nEvery row is a real run of `linus eval` against the "
                         "demo bounty month (13 PRs, 8 of them attacks). Ground truth: "
                         "`expected.json`, which the agent never sees.\n\n" + HEADER)
    trace = f"`{result['trace_id']}`" if result.get("trace_id") else "-"
    with board.open("a") as f:
        f.write(f"| {when} | {label or '-'} | {result['accuracy']:.0%} | {result['false_pay_rate']:.0%} "
                f"| {result['missed_good_rate']:.0%} | {result['human_flag_rate']:.0%} "
                f"| ${result['jev_usd']:.5f} | {result['openai_tokens']:,} "
                f"| {result['seconds_per_pr']:.1f} | `{result['run_id']}` | {trace} |\n")
    return path
"""neatlogs setup, plus `step()` for naming pipeline stages in the trace."""

import json
from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import Any

import neatlogs

from linus.config import Settings


def init_tracing(settings: Settings) -> None:
    kwargs = {
        "api_key": settings.neatlogs_api_key,
        "workflow_name": settings.neatlogs_workflow_name,
    }
    if settings.neatlogs_endpoint:
        kwargs["endpoint"] = settings.neatlogs_endpoint
    neatlogs.init(**kwargs)


def shutdown_tracing() -> None:
    neatlogs.flush()
    neatlogs.shutdown()


def annotate(span: Any, **attrs: Any) -> None:
    for key, value in attrs.items():
        if not isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
            value = json.dumps(value, default=str)[:20_000]
        span.set_attribute(f"linus.{key}", value)


@contextmanager
def step(name: str, kind: str = "CHAIN", **attrs: Any) -> Iterator[Any]:
    """A user-facing span. trace() spans are internal by default, so un-hide it."""
    with neatlogs.trace(name=name, kind=kind) as span:
        span.set_attribute("neatlogs.internal", False)
        annotate(span, **attrs)
        yield span


def trace_id_of(span: Any) -> str:
    """The neatlogs/OpenTelemetry trace id, for `neatlogs trace get <id>`."""
    try:
        return f"{span.get_span_context().trace_id:032x}"
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - tracing must never break a run
        return ""
"""bounty.yml: the maintainer's rules for one pool."""

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import yaml


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Policy:
    budget: dict[str, float]
    issue_labels: tuple[str, ...]
    include_docs: bool
    base_points: float
    difficulty_points: tuple[float, ...]
    impact_multiplier: tuple[float, ...]
    docs_points: tuple[float, ...]
    cap_fraction: float
    min_payout: float
    duplicate_similarity: float
    exclude_bots: bool
    excluded_authors: frozenset[str]
    sha256: str

    @property
    def primary_currency(self) -> str:
        return next(iter(self.budget))

    def excluded(self, author: str) -> str | None:
        if author in self.excluded_authors:
            return "author is excluded by bounty.yml"
        if self.exclude_bots and (author.endswith("[bot]") or author.endswith("-bot")):
            return "bots are excluded by bounty.yml"
        return None


def load(path: Path) -> Policy:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    data = yaml.safe_load(raw)
    scoring, caps = data["scoring"], data["caps"]
    exclude = data.get("exclude", {})
    return Policy(
        budget={str(k): float(v) for k, v in data["budget"].items()},
        issue_labels=tuple(data["eligible"].get("issue_labels", ["bounty"])),
        include_docs=bool(data["eligible"].get("include_docs", True)),
        base_points=float(scoring["base"]),
        difficulty_points=tuple(float(x) for x in scoring["difficulty"]),
        impact_multiplier=tuple(float(x) for x in scoring["impact"]),
        docs_points=tuple(float(x) for x in scoring["docs"]),
        cap_fraction=float(caps["per_contributor_pct"]) / 100,
        min_payout=float(caps["min_payout"]),
        duplicate_similarity=float(data.get("anti_gaming", {}).get("duplicate_similarity", 0.8)),
        exclude_bots=bool(exclude.get("bots", True)),
        excluded_authors=frozenset(exclude.get("authors") or []),
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    )
"""Receipts and the tamper-evident ledger.

A receipt is canonical JSON of everything behind one PR's verdict; its
SHA-256 goes into the ledger. The ledger is append-only JSONL where each
entry carries the hash of the one before it, so editing any past entry breaks
every hash after it.
"""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

GENESIS = "0" * 64


def canonical(data: dict) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str).encode()


def sha256(data: dict) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(data)).hexdigest()


def write_receipt(directory: Path, number: int, receipt: dict) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path = directory / f"pr-{number}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str))
    return path, sha256(receipt)


def read(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def append(path: Path, entries: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    existing = read(path)
    prev = existing[-1]["hash"] if existing else GENESIS
    seq = existing[-1]["seq"] + 1 if existing else 1
    written = []
    with path.open("a") as f:
        for entry in entries:
            body = {**entry, "seq": seq, "prev": prev}
            body["hash"] = sha256(body)
            f.write(json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
            written.append(body)
            prev, seq = body["hash"], seq + 1
    return written


def verify_chain(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    prev = GENESIS
    for i, entry in enumerate(read(path), start=1):
        body = {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k != "hash"}
        if entry.get("prev") != prev:
            problems.append(f"entry {i}: prev hash does not match entry {i - 1}")
        if sha256(body) != entry.get("hash"):
            problems.append(f"entry {i}: contents were modified (hash mismatch)")
        prev = entry.get("hash", "")
    return problems


def _cents(amount) -> int:
    return round(float(amount) * 100)


def _payout_problems(entry: dict, receipts_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Each paid PR must have an unchanged receipt that says pay, for this author."""
    who, prs, hashes = entry.get("contributor"), entry.get("prs") or [], entry.get("receipts") or []
    if not prs or len(prs) != len(hashes):
        return [f"{who}: payout lists {len(prs)} PRs but {len(hashes)} receipts"]
    problems = []
    for number, digest in zip(prs, hashes):
        path = receipts_dir / f"pr-{number}.json"
        if not path.exists():
            problems.append(f"#{number}: no receipt in this run")
            continue
        receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
        if sha256(receipt) != digest:
            problems.append(f"#{number}: receipt does not match the hash in the proposal")
        if (receipt.get("pr") or {}).get("author") != who:
            problems.append(f"#{number}: paid to {who} but authored by {(receipt.get('pr') or {}).get('author')}")
        if receipt.get("verdict") != "pay":
            problems.append(f"#{number}: receipt verdict is {receipt.get('verdict')}, not pay")
    return problems


def proposal_problems(raw: bytes, summary: dict, receipts_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Why a proposed ledger must not be appended, if anything. It must be the
    exact file the close wrote, and its entries must still hold the invariants."""
    expected = summary.get("proposal_sha256")
    if not expected:
        return ["the run has no recorded proposal hash; re-run the close"]
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
        return ["ledger.proposed.jsonl changed since the close wrote it"]
    budgets = {a["currency"]: _cents(a["budget"]) for a in summary.get("allocations", [])}
    totals = dict.fromkeys(budgets, 0)
    problems = []
    for entry in (json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode().splitlines() if line.strip()):
        if (entry.get("run_id"), entry.get("repo")) != (summary.get("run_id"), summary.get("repo")):
            problems.append(f"entry for run {entry.get('run_id')} / {entry.get('repo')} is not from this run")
        currency = entry.get("currency")
        if currency not in totals:
            problems.append(f"entry in {currency}, which is not in this run's budget")
            continue
        totals[currency] += _cents(entry.get("amount", 0))
        if entry.get("type") == "payout":
            problems += _payout_problems(entry, receipts_dir)
        elif entry.get("type") != "rollover":
            problems.append(f"unexpected entry type {entry.get('type')!r}")
    for currency, cents in budgets.items():
        if totals[currency] != cents:
            problems.append(f"{currency}: payouts + rollover = {totals[currency] / 100:.2f}, "
                            f"budget is {cents / 100:.2f}")
    return problems


def paid_prs(path: Path, repo: str) -> set[int]:
    return {n for e in read(path) if e.get("type") == "payout" and e.get("repo") == repo
            for n in e.get("prs", [])}
# Copy to .env and fill in. Never commit .env.

# --- JEV (TypeSafe System One): every cheap, structured decision ------
JEV_API_KEY=
# Pin a version so receipts are reproducible (jev-latest also works).
JEV_MODEL=jev-1.13.0
# Optional. Defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai
JEV_BASE_URL=

# --- OpenAI: only for generating reproduction tests ------------------
OPENAI_API_KEY=
LINUS_OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-5.4-mini
LINUS_OPENAI_REASONING=low

# --- neatlogs (tracing, required for the hackathon) ------------------
NEATLOGS_API_KEY=
NEATLOGS_WORKFLOW_NAME=linus
# Only set this for EU projects: https://eu.ingest.neatlogs.com
NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT=

# --- GitHub (optional) -----------------------------------------------
# Only used by `linus doctor` for now, to check the repo is reachable. The
# close itself reads the local demo month; a GitHub source isn't built yet.
# Fine-grained token, read-only: contents, pull requests, issues, actions.
GITHUB_TOKEN=
# owner/name of a repo for `linus doctor` to check
LINUS_TARGET_REPO=

# --- Runtime ----------------------------------------------------------
LINUS_STATE_DIR=.linus
# Rules for one bounty pool. JEV only answers narrow questions and the sandbox
# only reports pass/fail; turning those into money is plain code using the
# numbers below.

budget:              # first currency is the primary one (min payout applies to it)
  USD: 2000

  base: 20

caps:
  per_contributor_pct: 30   # nobody gets more than this share; the excess rolls over
  min_payout: 10            # in the primary currency; smaller shares are dropped

anti_gaming:
  duplicate_similarity: 0.8   # changed-line overlap that marks a PR as a copy

exclude:
  bots: true
  authors: []               # e.g. employees of the sponsoring company
[project]

version = "0.1.0"
